Game description
A relentless alien force spreads its corruption across the stars. To reclaim the galaxy, you must hold the line against an endless onslaught and turn the tide to restore peace.
Prepare for the final alien battle!

Orbitfall is a 6-to-8 row, 6 column galactic slot that comes with wilds, multipliers, big symbols, lazers, endless battle, a bonus and all packed into a potential of 7,500x!

is a 6-to-8 row, 6 column galactic slot that comes with wilds, multipliers, big symbols, lazers, endless battle, a bonus and all packed into a potential of 7,500x!

The blockers release different features: redrops, multipliers and level clear. There are also Lazer and Alien attack features which remove symbols and blockers. Finally, there is a bonus game with free drops.

X-iter rules
The X-iter feature offers several different game modes.
Endless Annihilation: Guaranteed entry to the final level with a boosted start with multiple features at the cost of __X05_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Bonus: Guaranteed entry to the bonus game at the cost of __X04_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Play Among the Stars: Guarantees a game round that starts in the final level at the cost of __X03_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Fleetcall: Guarantees a game round that starts at game level 2 at the cost of __X02_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
Bonus Hunt: One drop with more than 4 times the chance to trigger the bonus game at the cost of __X01_MULTIPLIER__ the selected bet.
